# Brad Schmitz

> Brad Schmitz (Bradley Schmitz) is a Denver, CO-based creative technologist, software engineer, and musician. He builds projection-mapped installations, VR/AR experiences, audio-reactive visuals, and generative music, working mainly in TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine, Unity, Three.js, and Ableton Live. He releases indie folk music as "dolphinswarm".

Brad is a software engineer at ClickTime and was previously a creative technologist at XR Studios. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science and a B.A. in Interactive Media Studies from Miami University (Ohio), with minors in Music Composition and Music Performance (Saxophone). His work sits where technology, art, and music meet: interactive systems that make light, sound, motion, and space feel responsive.

- Location: Denver, Colorado, USA
- Roles: Creative Technologist, Software Engineer, Musician
- Creative tools: TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine, Unity, Three.js / React Three Fiber, OpenGL/GLSL, Vulkan, Adobe Suite
- Music tools: Ableton Live, Max/MSP, MIDI
- Programming: TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, C/C++, Python, Java, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL
- Instruments: saxophone (alto, tenor, soprano, baritone), guitar, banjo, bass, piano

## Selected work

- FuTerra | I Was The Earth (2024): Installation at the BLINK 2024 festival with &FRIENDS Studio; Brad also composed its generative music
- With/in: The Dance Between Being & Becoming: Art for a Denver clock tower with &FRIENDS Studio, shown at Night Lights Denver; Brad also composed its music
- Gathering at the Poet's Shack (2020): Projection-mapped installation at Miami University, including a TouchDesigner poem visualizer and a Kinect-driven interactive projection on Upham Arch
- Parkinson's VR Training (2021): Virtual reality training simulation built in Unity and C#
- VRchery: Virtual reality archery game
- AR Looper: Augmented reality music looper
- The Ultimate Drum Machine: Browser-based 16-step drum sequencer
- This website: A 3D portfolio built with Next.js and React Three Fiber
